purpose: Closer literature-inspired baseline: estimate unseen depth features from RGB, then prioritise expected prediction change. Not an exact reproduction of CAMA, whose main task and metrics are binary classification.
imputer: RGB RBF-kernel ridge to frozen depth descriptors, alpha .01/.1/1/10/100 and bandwidth .5/1/2; normalise imputed descriptors before joint prediction
residuals: For each training animal, predict depth from other training animals with the same selected parameter identity. Use all training residual vectors equally as additive conditional draws; normalise each draw. No test depth used for acquisition scores.
selection: Inner-validation mean routed MAE at depth frame caps .25/.5/.75, same outer animal splits and exact 0-1 knapsack as existing binary gate
scope: A small-data conditional-imputation comparator, not a claim of replicating published deep generative acquisition systems.
